capabilities: Hover over Chinese text to show a popup with pinyin and English definitions
Handle simplified and traditional characters, optionally showing both
Save hovered words to a word list note in the vault
Look up words offline via a bundled CC-CEDICT dictionary
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the dictionary is bundled so no internet connection is needed, and the plugin inherits GPL-2.0 from Zhongwen.
intentEvidence: Inspired by: Zhongwen — the Chrome/Firefox popup dictionary by Christian Schiller.
problem: Reading Chinese in Obsidian normally means switching to a separate dictionary tool or browser extension to look up characters and pinyin.

relations.evidence: Inspired by: Zhongwen — the Chrome/Firefox popup dictionary by Christian Schiller.
Powered by CC-CEDICT, a trusted open-source Chinese-English dictionary, bundled with the plugin

summary: Hover popup dictionary that shows tone-colored pinyin and CC-CEDICT English definitions for Chinese text in the editor and Reading view.
